value.rationale: The precise double transverse-flip boundary is a natural complete bifurcation classification for the simplest antisymmetric two-site realization of a newly studied disordered-logistic family. It exposes an exceptional invariant 1D subsystem and a physically admissible attracting–saddle–attracting coupling sequence, giving a useful structural boundary to typical-disorder heuristics rather than a routine 1D logistic fact.
